verdict.rationale: Community posts report independent multi-core benchmark results for M5. A leaked Geekbench run shows roughly 15,437 vs 13,324 against M4, about 15% higher, with a note of the same max clock and an IPC gain (comm-12, comm-13). A relayed claim of 15% faster multithreaded CPU performance and a pure-C throughput comparison add some corroboration. However, the first-party specs in the pack list only GPU cores, Neural Engine cores and memory bandwidth, with no CPU core count and no documented boost or clock behavior. missing for 10: documented CPU core counts (performance/efficiency split), documented boost/clock behavior, independent sustained compile or parallel-build benchmarks beyond a leaked Geekbench score.
